items.question: 平台上一共收录了多少位艺术家？
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS artist_count FROM artist LIMIT 1000

items.question: 把平台支持的所有媒体类型名称列出来，按名称升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT name FROM media_type ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 1000

items.question: 标准单价为 0.99 的曲目一共有多少首？
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM track WHERE unit_price = 0.99 LIMIT 1000

items.question: 全平台时长最长的一首曲目，时长是多少毫秒？
items.sql: SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_milliseconds FROM track LIMIT 1000

items.question: 平台上一共有多少个播放列表？
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS playlist_count FROM playlist LIMIT 1000

items.question: 请按客户姓氏的字母顺序升序列出前 10 位客户的姓和名。
items.sql: SELECT last_name, first_name FROM customer ORDER BY last_name ASC LIMIT 10;

items.question: 金额最高的一张发票，总金额是多少？
items.sql:
SELECT total AS highest_invoice_amount
FROM invoice
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: 按客户所在国家统计客户数量，列出客户数最多的 5 个国家及其客户数；客户数相同时按国家名称升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country ASC LIMIT 5;

items.question: 曲目有几种标准单价？每种单价各有多少首曲目？按单价升序排列，给出单价和曲目数。
items.sql:
SELECT unit_price, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM track
GROUP BY unit_price
ORDER BY unit_price ASC;

items.question: 列出所有职位为『Sales Support Agent』的员工的姓、名和联系电话，按姓氏升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT last_name, first_name, phone FROM employee WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY last_name ASC LIMIT 1000

items.question: 统计每位作曲者名下的曲目数量（作曲者为空的跳过不计），列出曲目数最多的 5 位作曲者及其曲目数；曲目数相同时按作曲者名称升序排列。

items.question: 有多少位客户没有登记传真号码（fax 为空）？
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE fax IS NULL LIMIT 1000

items.question: 按账单国家统计发票数量，只保留发票数达到 20 张及以上的国家；给出国家名称和发票数，按发票数从多到少、国家名称升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT billing_country AS country_name, COUNT(invoice_id) AS invoice_count FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country HAVING COUNT(invoice_id) >= 20 ORDER BY invoice_count DESC, country_name ASC;

items.question: 所有发票明细行的购买数量加起来一共是多少？
items.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM invoice_line LIMIT 1000

items.question: 找出名称重复的曲目：列出出现次数最多的 10 个重复曲目名称以及各自出现的次数，按出现次数从多到少、名称升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT name AS track_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count FROM track GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10;

items.question: 按账单国家统计平均发票金额，只保留平均金额高于 6 的国家；给出国家名称和平均金额（保留两位小数），按平均金额从高到低、国家名称升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT billing_country AS country, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_amount FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country HAVING AVG(total) > 6 ORDER BY average_amount DESC, country ASC;

items.question: 把曲目时长从毫秒换算成秒（保留一位小数），列出时长最长的 10 首曲目的名称和秒数，按秒数从长到短、曲目名称升序排列。
items.detail: live[:2]=[('Occupation / Precipice', 5286.0), ('Through a Looking Glass', 5088.0)] vs gold[:2]=[('Occupation / Precipice', 5287.0), ('Through a Looking Glass', 5088.8)]
items.sql: SELECT name AS track_name, ROUND(milliseconds / 1000, 1) AS duration_seconds FROM track ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10;

items.question: 统计每位管理者直接管理了几名下属（没有下属的人不出现在结果里）；给出管理者的员工编号和直接下属人数，按下属人数从多到少、员工编号升序排列。
items.sql: SELECT m.employee_id AS manager_id, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS direct_report_count FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id GROUP BY m.employee_id ORDER BY direct_report_count DESC, manager_id ASC

items.question: 有多少张发票的金额高于所有发票的平均金额？
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoice WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM invoice) LIMIT 1000
